Closed periods lock writes by default; unlocking is approval-gated and only for material post-close accruals; insert-only with full audit log.
Insert-only ledger with reversals - no edits to journal entries; corrections reverse and rebook. Period closes define immutability. Monitoring over rollback. Euro-only, multi-currency deferred.

decisions.text: An approval publishes the whole history under a single date and is insert-only - the period pickers are navigation and never scope what is published. The snapshot holds one whole-year ledger per fiscal year in the render layer's serialized shape plus cash and bank movement per period, and carries a version so an unrecognised payload is reported unreadable rather than mis-rendered. The Exact division is its own column, not just a field inside the payload.
